Name: Lavender Dreams UI Recolor
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Verdana][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/color][/font][font=Verdana]
This mod gives all the UI in Stardew Valley a new, all natural lavender-themed coat of paint. Perfect for purple lovers and cottagecore players alike! [font=Verdana]It features several custom assets to give the UI a completely [/font]new vibe, and even has unique title screen easter eggs if you have certain mods installed! ;)

You can install it like any other mod, just by unzipping it and placing it in your mods folder. Update by deleting the previous version and installing the new one. Works via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

[size=4][b][color=#8e7cc3]Configuration[/color][/b][/size]
This recolor currently offers several configuration options. Launch the game with this mod installed and edit the generated [b]config.json[/b] to your preferences. Alternatively can be configured via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. All are set to [b][u]true[/u][/b] by default.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Custom Cursors[/b] - [u]true[/u] edits the cursors to fit the color scheme and theme the rest of the recolor has. [u]false[/u] turns off the edit; use if you would like to use your own set of custom cursors (or prefer the vanilla cursors).[/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Seasonal Portrait Decor[/b] - [u]true[/u] adds plants and other naturalistic decorations around the portrait window that appears during dialogue. Each in-game season has different decor, as do the desert and Ginger Island. [u]false[/u] removes this overlay, useful if you're already using a portrait overlay mod or merely want a simpler interface.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Friendship Indicator [/b]- [u]true[/u] edits the small orb in the portrait window that indicates your friendship level with someone into a flower. [u]false[/u] turns off this edit.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Artifact Spot Toggle[/b] - [u]true[/u] changes the worms that appear for artifact spots into a lavender-like plant. [u]false[/u] leaves them as the default worms.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Artifact Spot Color [/b]- This configuration option lets you choose the color of the flower for the artifact spots. Colors offered include: [u]blue[/u], [u]lavender[/u], [u]pink[/u], [u]red[/u], [u]white[/u], and [u]yellow[/u]. Set to [u]lavender[/u] by default. There are also [u]random[/u] and [u]seasonal[/u] options. [u]random[/u] will make the flower color randomize each day and [u]seasonal[/u] will make the flower match whichever season it currently is in-game. If you are using GMCM to configure this mod, you may have to scroll the drop-down for this setting to see all the options.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]

[font=Verdana][font=Verdana][b][u][color=#ffff00]TO USE:[/color][/u][/b] Go inside the folder for Lavender Dreams and copy the folder for the mod you want to add compat for from the [b]compatibilitypatches [/b]folder. Paste the folder into your Mods folder and say yes to replacing the files. Your UI will now be a beautiful lavender color~ [b]Keep in mind you will have to repeat this process any time you update one of these mods.[/b][/font]

[font=Verdana][b][u][color=#ffff00]NOTE:[/color][/u] [/b]Mods with an ASTERISK (*) do NOT need anything special done for compatibility; they will be recolored automatically, even after updating the mod in question.[/font] You do not need to do the  process described above to make them the appropriate color.

This mod [i]should[/i] be compatible with Android SMAPI. I do not have access to the proper tools to develop/bugtest mobile support so you're most likely on your own if you run into bugs with that, unfortunately.[/font]

[font=Verdana]If you are still on Stardew 1.5.6, there is an old version of the mod available in the old file section you can use.[size=4]

[*][font=Verdana][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url]﻿ - If you want to use a rustic font along with your rustic UI![/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16210]Smallcopper's Icons[/url]﻿ - An alternate option for pretty desaturated friendship indicators :3[/font][/*]

[*][font=Verdana][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17242]Vintage Reshade[/url]﻿ - A gorgeous Reshade preset which offers special compatibility with Lavender Dreams![/font][/*]
